identifier_rule: Final CAD manifest resolves purchased items directly to electrical BOM IDs. purchased_aliases below records earlier reference labels for traceability, not a second set of parts. The generated mechanical-bom.json owns custom/fastener/site entries.
quantity_rule: Use each local assembly exactly once. TOP_PASSIVE/TOP_RESEARCH repeat placed component geometry and must not add another purchased quantity. Optional assemblies do not populate the default build. Enclosure shell/lid, PCB/component envelopes and split model representations share one parent item, not separate orders.

unresolved_reference_items.FAST-HUB-M6-SPACER: Candidate M6-clearance spacer geometry; exact standard, length/washer/joint, material, supplier and torque not released.
unresolved_reference_items.FAST-PI-M2P5-STANDOFF: Candidate M2.5 Pi support; exact threaded standoff, screw/head, washer stack and torque not released.
unresolved_reference_items.ACT-ISOLATOR-01: Generic elastomer annulus; exact material/durometer/preload, supplier and vibration/retention qualification open.
unresolved_reference_items.SITE-PIPE-01: Illustrative 60 mm farm rail, not a purchased component or surveyed infrastructure.

custom_part_rule: CAD-* and PRINT-* BOM IDs resolve to their editable CAD construction, part features, material/finish assumptions and drawings in the manifest. Group equal BOM IDs by local assembly to obtain geometry counts. These are not vendor SKUs or released fabricated parts; missing joining, fastener, restraint or material specifications remain release holds.
fixture_quantity_rule: Instrument reference envelopes inside calibration/pressure-positioning fixtures are reused test specimens, not additional instrument procurement. Fixture build quantities require test-plan approval.
unmodeled_electrical_items: BMS, protections, USB-C source, complete wet penetrators, gateway and detailed harness components remain open in the electrical BOM. A valid CAD envelope does not imply these missing components fit or are selected.
